document.abstract: In order to make the purpose of this paper clear, I will first define “trick photographer.” This unfortunately is the nearest term that I know for describing the person in a big studio who is called upon to do the parts of a production which are out of the usual run. In the word “needs” I refer particularly to material, apparatus, etc., besides what is already available and particularly suited for the problems which a trick photographer has to solve.
